status: Proposed operating model — for owner review

documents.title: Business & product charter
documents.purpose: Keep one stable definition of what we are building.
documents.contents: Buyer, promise, core offer, exclusions, agency versus software path, success measures.
documents.inputs: Owner decisions and current launch plan
documents.gate: Owner accepts the launch scope; revisit only at a scheduled review.

documents.title: Service catalogue & scope rules
documents.purpose: Sell work that can be delivered consistently.
documents.contents: Core services, optional modules, quantities, revision limits, client duties, exclusions and dependencies.
documents.inputs: Delivery experience and available capacity
documents.gate: Every proposed line item maps to a deliverable and an owner.

documents.title: Pricing & capacity model
documents.purpose: Check that sold work leaves time and margin.
documents.contents: Founder hours, direct costs, software costs, margin assumption, revision allowance, capacity and payment milestones.
documents.inputs: Observed time and supplier costs; owner-selected fees
documents.gate: Owner approves actual fees; unknown costs remain unknown. No client pricing inferred from another client.

documents.title: Launch roadmap & decision log
documents.purpose: Prevent drift and keep the next action visible.
documents.contents: One outcome, ordered backlog, dependencies, weekly focus, parked ideas and dated decisions.
documents.inputs: Charter and available hours
documents.gate: Every active task contributes to the current milestone; one build and one delivery batch in progress.

documents.title: Skill registry & workflow specification
documents.purpose: Make skills discoverable and run them in the right order.
documents.contents: Triggers, inputs, prerequisites, output schemas, quality gates, owners, permissions and versions.
documents.inputs: This operating plan and inspected installed skills
documents.gate: Record artifact quality, workflow evaluation and application integration separately; retain fixture results and regression failures.

documents.title: Prospect & qualification brief
documents.purpose: Decide whether this opportunity is worth pursuing.
documents.contents: Business identity, URLs, requested outcomes, contact source, budget unknowns, timing and fit decision.
documents.inputs: Enquiry or authorised public sources
documents.gate: Identity and business URLs checked; proceed, clarify, defer or decline recorded.

documents.title: Evidence & source register
documents.purpose: Give every material claim a traceable source.
documents.contents: Source, date, claim, authority, uncertainty, permissions and conflicts.
documents.inputs: Website, supplied material, public channels and discovery answers
documents.gate: Observations are separated from assumptions and private data that is unavailable.

documents.title: External presence audit
documents.purpose: Identify visible friction and useful opportunities.
documents.contents: Website journey, messaging, social presence, creative consistency, enquiry path; five strongest findings.
documents.inputs: Qualified prospect and dated evidence
documents.gate: Each finding links to evidence and a concrete action; no invented traffic, revenue or reach.

documents.title: Audience & competitor research
documents.purpose: Deepen a decision that the basic audit cannot resolve.
documents.contents: Buying situations, audience questions, alternatives, competitor patterns and research limits.
documents.inputs: Audit gaps, interviews or authorised research
documents.gate: Commission depth only when it changes scope, positioning or channel choice.

documents.title: Opportunity & service map
documents.purpose: Connect problems to a small, sellable scope.
documents.contents: Problem → evidence → proposed service → deliverable → intended outcome → measurement.
documents.inputs: Audit, client priorities and service catalogue
documents.gate: Owner selects a coherent scope; expected effects are hypotheses, not promised results.

documents.title: Proposal creative direction
documents.purpose: Make the proposed future tangible before expanding production.
documents.contents: Retained brand equity, working palette/type, voice samples, visual thesis and selected applications.
documents.inputs: Verified facts, existing assets, opportunity map
documents.output: direction.html + draft tokens and voice extracts
documents.gate: Internally selected proposal direction; client acceptance is recorded separately.

documents.title: Mockup & preview pack
documents.purpose: Demonstrate the services being sold.
documents.contents: Representative finished feed, Story, web or email examples for selected scope; provenance and example labels.
documents.inputs: Proposal direction and actual selected services
documents.gate: Examples are coherent and fact-checked; sample volume and presale effort are agreed internally.

documents.title: Interactive proposal & scope
documents.purpose: Combine diagnosis, solution, proof and investment in one decision.
documents.contents: Findings, selected services, previews, deliverables, timeline, pricing, exclusions, next step and decision record.
documents.inputs: Opportunity map, reviewed mockups and owner-approved fees
documents.gate: Scope and price reconcile; draft, optional and accepted services stay distinct.

documents.title: Agreement & statement of work
documents.purpose: Record the exact commercial commitment.
documents.contents: Parties, selected scope, fee schedule, revisions, responsibilities, term, rights and termination terms.
documents.inputs: Accepted proposal version and appropriate reviewed agreement template
documents.gate: Client and agency complete the agreed signing route. Contract text and signing implementation need their own review.

documents.title: Acceptance & payment record
documents.purpose: Turn a sales decision into a clear operational state.
documents.contents: Accepted scope version, signer, timestamp, payment milestone, receipt reference and kickoff conditions. Reconcile authoritative signing/payment status; repeated events must not duplicate client activation.
documents.inputs: Signed agreement and verified payment evidence
documents.gate: A clicked HTML button is an intent signal; signed and paid states require verified evidence.

documents.title: Kickoff & confirmed client brief
documents.purpose: Confirm what research could not know.
documents.contents: Goals, offerings, audiences, locales, contacts, dates, factual restrictions and success definition. Prefill known answers, show sources, and ask only consequential gaps.
documents.inputs: Accepted scope, evidence register and client answers
documents.gate: Client confirms material facts; missing inputs receive an owner and due date.

documents.title: Access, assets & rights register
documents.purpose: Know which materials and accounts can be used.
documents.contents: Account ownership, role/access status, original assets, licences, generated/real provenance and missing assets.
documents.inputs: Client-provided access and files
documents.gate: Access and permitted uses confirmed per service; store secret references, never passwords in documents.

documents.title: Approval & communication plan
documents.purpose: Avoid stalled work and ambiguous approval.
documents.contents: Reviewers, channels, response windows, versioned decisions, revision rounds and escalation.
documents.inputs: Client team and agreed scope
documents.gate: Named reviewer and backup; silence does not automatically approve content.

documents.title: Delivery plan & milestone schedule
documents.purpose: Translate sold scope into an achievable schedule.
documents.contents: Deliverable counters, dependencies, tasks, founder capacity, client deadlines and meeting rhythm. Track hands-on time, waiting, rework and work in progress separately.
documents.inputs: SOW, access status and approval plan
documents.gate: First batch fits capacity and inputs; blocked work is visible before a due date is promised.

documents.title: Brand strategy & positioning
documents.purpose: Define what the business means and why someone chooses it.
documents.contents: Audience, buying situation, offer, substantiated differentiation, promise, personality and strategic priorities.
documents.inputs: Confirmed brief and evidence
documents.gate: Client accepts the direction; an existing approved strategy can be adopted after a gap check.

documents.title: Messaging & offer architecture
documents.purpose: Keep every channel clear about what is being sold.
documents.contents: Message hierarchy, value propositions, offer descriptions, proof, objections and CTAs.
documents.inputs: Positioning and verified offerings
documents.gate: Claims are supported; messages are tested in a website intro, social post and email opening.

documents.title: Tone of voice & writing playbook
documents.purpose: Let each writing skill sound like the same business.
documents.contents: Voice traits as writing actions, contextual tone, language rules, caption structures and annotated examples.
documents.inputs: Positioning, approved writing, locales and feedback
documents.gate: Accept a specific version after varied examples; existing mc-brand-voice is the starting skill.

documents.title: Visual identity & design system
documents.purpose: Make visual work consistent and reusable.
documents.contents: Logo usage, palette, typography, spacing, grids, imagery, graphic language, motion and accessibility rules. Use named, typed design tokens and aliases; record the version used by each application.
documents.inputs: Existing identity, selected direction, rights and applications
documents.gate: Prove the rules in three relevant applications. Adopt existing rules where they work; record gaps.

documents.title: Logo design & identity change
documents.purpose: Create or change a logo only when the brief requires it.
documents.contents: Discovery, concepts, rationale, optical variants, clear space, small-size checks and production exports.
documents.inputs: Approved identity brief and explicit sold scope
documents.gate: Selected mark approved before extending the identity; usage/rights checks remain explicit.

documents.title: Art direction & image production guide
documents.purpose: Give photography, AI imagery and graphics a recognizable point of view.
documents.contents: Subject families, composition, lighting, styling, reference roles, crop rules and factual fidelity.
documents.inputs: Visual system, product/service facts and available assets
documents.gate: Review representative images and label real, generated, composite and reference assets.

documents.title: Reusable application templates
documents.purpose: Turn approved rules into fast, editable production.
documents.contents: Selected carousel, feed, Story, ad, web and email layouts; flexible content limits and examples.
documents.inputs: Approved voice, messaging and design system
documents.gate: Build only contracted formats; test long copy, different imagery and mobile/export states.

documents.title: Client knowledge index & version manifest
documents.purpose: Give downstream skills one reliable entry point.
documents.contents: Current approved artifacts, sources, offerings, scope, permitted use, versions and known gaps.
documents.inputs: Reviewed foundation pack and client identifier
documents.gate: All references stay within this client; expired, rejected and superseded versions cannot silently activate.

documents.title: Social media strategy
documents.purpose: Define how social content supports the business.
documents.contents: Audience journey, channel roles, pillars, recurring formats, cadence hypothesis, response plan and measurement.
documents.inputs: Foundation pack, goals, scope and channel baseline
documents.gate: Owner/client accept the strategy; volume matches sold scope and production capacity.

documents.title: Campaign & content calendar
documents.purpose: Connect a month of content to one coherent purpose.
documents.contents: Themes, asset IDs, grid positions, separate posting chronology, formats, captions, CTA and review status.
documents.inputs: Social strategy, events, assets and scope
documents.gate: Grid and chronology are reviewed separately; draft dates and confirmed scheduled dates differ.

documents.title: Creative briefs & copy pack
documents.purpose: Give each output enough direction to be made well.
documents.contents: Objective, audience, message, source facts, composition, copy, format and QA criteria per asset.
documents.inputs: Calendar and approved foundation versions
documents.gate: Every creative links to its brief and exact source versions; claims are preserved.

documents.title: Production & publishing checklist
documents.purpose: Release the correct creative to the correct destination once.
documents.contents: Originals, crop, copy, alt text, account, date/time zone, approval, retry handling and provider confirmation.
documents.inputs: Reviewed assets/copy and authorised connected accounts
documents.gate: Approval → authorised submit → provider reconciliation; failures are not marked published.

documents.title: Website strategy & conversion brief
documents.purpose: Define the website around customer decisions.
documents.contents: Audience tasks, offer hierarchy, conversion goal, sitemap, integrations, content ownership and measurement.
documents.inputs: Foundation pack and selected website scope
documents.gate: Sitemap and conversion journey accepted before detailed page production.

documents.title: Website content & wireframes
documents.purpose: Resolve information and journeys before visual polish.
documents.contents: Page copy, section purpose, CTAs, form states, navigation, content sources and mobile hierarchy.
documents.inputs: Approved website brief, facts and messaging
documents.gate: Content and user journeys reviewed; missing claims/assets explicitly marked.

documents.title: Website UI, components & handoff
documents.purpose: Apply the brand to a working web experience.
documents.contents: Responsive screens, component states, motion, interaction specifications and developer handoff.
documents.inputs: Approved wireframes, tokens and voice
documents.output: Editable design + component specs + implementation handoff
documents.gate: Desktop/mobile and interactions inspected; visual approval does not mean deployment.

documents.title: Website launch & maintenance plan
documents.purpose: Make launch and ongoing ownership explicit.
documents.contents: Forms, links, accessibility, SEO basics, analytics, domains, redirects, backups and ownership.
documents.inputs: Built site, content approval and actual integration access
documents.output: QA evidence + launch runbook + maintenance scope
documents.gate: Critical journeys pass and deployment is authorised; verify the actual live result.

documents.title: Email lifecycle & campaign strategy
documents.purpose: Choose useful emails for real audience needs.
documents.contents: Audience segments, signup sources, welcome/retention journeys, campaign roles, frequency and measurement.
documents.inputs: Foundation pack, offer, list-source/permission information
documents.gate: Sending eligibility and audience/source handling established before production activation.

documents.title: Email templates, copy & QA pack
documents.purpose: Create reusable, reviewable campaigns.
documents.contents: Subject/preheader, responsive layouts, copy modules, links, footer, unsubscribe/suppression handling and rendering checks.
documents.inputs: Email strategy, voice, tokens and provider capability
documents.output: Editable email template + copy + test evidence
documents.gate: Approved test rendering and audience/links checked; send authority is separate.

documents.title: Paid campaign & creative test plan
documents.purpose: Give ads a measurable offer and a controlled test.
documents.contents: Objective, offer, audiences, creative hypotheses, landing destination, tracking, budget and stop/review rules.
documents.inputs: Scope, verified offer, foundation and approved budget
documents.gate: Creative, tracking and spend are approved independently; no invented performance forecast.

documents.title: Photo/video brief & storyboard
documents.purpose: Direct real or AI-assisted production consistently.
documents.contents: Shot list, scenes, script, references, provenance, aspect ratios, editable overlays and delivery formats.
documents.inputs: Art direction, verified subjects and campaign brief
documents.gate: Representative frame/scene reviewed before expanding; budget and generation permissions recorded.

documents.title: Graphic design & print production brief
documents.purpose: Adapt the system to non-social applications.
documents.contents: Purpose, copy, dimensions, material/specification, layouts, print/vendor requirements and exports.
documents.inputs: Brand system, approved copy and destination specs
documents.gate: Inspect at intended size; physical/vendor proof where required.

documents.title: SEO & editorial plan
documents.purpose: Plan useful search content from evidence and business priorities.
documents.contents: Audience questions, search evidence, topic clusters, page briefs, internal links and measurement.
documents.inputs: Website scope, business facts and fresh search research
documents.gate: Research supports prioritisation; no ranking guarantees or invented volumes.

documents.title: Support knowledge & escalation playbook
documents.purpose: Prepare helpful, bounded customer replies.
documents.contents: Approved FAQs, source answers, tone, unanswered questions, escalation contacts and action limits.
documents.inputs: Approved facts, voice and support scope
documents.gate: Start with reviewed suggestions; account-changing actions need connected systems and authority.

documents.title: Measurement plan & baseline
documents.purpose: Know what success can actually be measured.
documents.contents: Objective, metric definition, data source, baseline/date, access limits, cadence and attribution caveats.
documents.inputs: Agreed objectives and available source data
documents.gate: Unknowns stay unknown; differentiate observed results from interpretation.

documents.title: Monthly report & next actions
documents.purpose: Make the next month better using observed results.
documents.contents: Work delivered, source-dated metrics, useful comparisons, creative learning and next priorities.
documents.inputs: Delivery log, measurement plan and actual metrics
documents.gate: Numbers reconcile to dated sources; recommendations link to evidence or named hypotheses.

documents.title: Review, change request & renewal
documents.purpose: Keep feedback and scope changes controlled.
documents.contents: Decision log, revision reason, affected outputs, price/time impact, renewal goals and sign-off.
documents.inputs: Client feedback, contract and delivery economics
documents.gate: Approve changed scope/version before new commitments; do not silently overwrite approved work.

documents.title: Handover & offboarding pack
documents.purpose: Close or transfer work without losing history.
documents.contents: Final deliverables, ownership, scheduled items, account/access inventory, outstanding fees and agreed cutoff.
documents.inputs: Contract, delivery history and account ownership
documents.gate: Confirm transfer and remaining scheduled work before revoking access or archiving.

documents.title: MC Studios positioning & offer page
documents.purpose: Make the launch understandable and give enquiries somewhere to go.
documents.contents: Who we help, managed service promise, proof, scope, working process, fit questions and contact route.
documents.inputs: Charter, own foundation pack and approved commercial offer
documents.output: Agency landing page + Instagram bio/pinned-post copy
documents.gate: A visitor can understand the offer and submit a test enquiry successfully.

documents.title: Case study & portfolio permission pack
documents.purpose: Show real quality with a defensible story.
documents.contents: Challenge, actual work, creative decisions, selected applications, factual outcomes and permission record.
documents.inputs: Client-approved portfolio assets or clearly labelled original concept
documents.gate: No fabricated results or implied client approval; selected public material is cleared.

documents.title: Instagram launch kit & four-week plan
documents.purpose: Start posting with a repeatable system.
documents.contents: Three pinned topics, two-week ready buffer, showcase/education/process formats, CTAs and lead-source tags.
documents.inputs: Own voice/design system, offer page and case study
documents.output: Editable templates + final launch batch + content calendar
documents.gate: First batch approved; enquiry route and manual response process tested before posting.

documents.title: Lead resource & enquiry follow-up
documents.purpose: Turn interest into a useful next conversation.
documents.contents: One-page brand/content brief, fulfilment checklist, qualification questions and reply templates.
documents.inputs: Offer, audience questions and available service capacity
documents.gate: Deliver the promised resource; a resource request is not blanket permission for further campaigns.

stages.title: Understand the opportunity
stages.desc: A lead becomes a researched, qualified opportunity.
stages.input: Business URL, enquiry and basic discovery answers.
stages.skills: Knowledge retrieval → qualification → public audit → opportunity map
stages.outputs: Prospect brief, evidence register, audit and ranked service map.
stages.gate: Owner decides proceed / clarify / defer / decline.
stages.next: Proceed opens a proposal brief; unresolved facts become visible questions.
stages.time: Planning allowance: 2–4 focused hours for a light audit.
stages.failure: Insufficient evidence → ask targeted questions. Poor fit → pause or decline.

stages.title: Show the future clearly
stages.desc: Sell a coherent outcome with client-specific examples.
stages.input: Qualified opportunity, existing brand and selected proposed services.
stages.skills: Working direction → representative mockups → scope/pricing → proposal assembly
stages.outputs: Branded HTML proposal, finished service examples, scoped investment and delivery outline.
stages.gate: Owner reviews facts, creative, scope and pricing before authorised presentation.
stages.next: Client selections are captured against a specific proposal version.
stages.time: Set a presale effort budget; expand the preview pack when it helps the sale.
stages.failure: Scope changes → recalculate price and schedule, then issue a new proposal version.

stages.title: Make the commitment explicit
stages.desc: Keep intent, signature and payment as separate states.
stages.input: Accepted proposal selection and reviewed commercial terms.
stages.skills: Scope freeze → SOW assembly → signing route → payment verification
stages.outputs: Agreement, immutable scope reference, acceptance and payment evidence.
stages.gate: Agreement completed and agreed kickoff payment conditions satisfied.
stages.next: Convert prospect to a client record exactly once; retain all accepted artifacts.
stages.time: Client/legal/payment waiting time is separate from production effort.
stages.failure: Changed terms or failed payment → hold kickoff and resolve the specific issue.

stages.title: Confirm facts and access
stages.desc: Prefill from the proposal, then ask only what is missing.
stages.input: Signed scope, research, selected creative and client contacts.
stages.skills: Client brief → asset/access intake → approval plan → milestone plan
stages.outputs: Confirmed brief, permitted assets, reviewer map and first delivery plan.
stages.gate: Critical inputs and owners are known; service-specific blockers are recorded.
stages.next: Foundation work opens for enabled services; unrelated optional modules stay off.
stages.time: Target a short kickoff and focused follow-up, not a giant blank questionnaire.
stages.failure: Missing account or asset → block only affected production tasks, with an owner/due date.

stages.title: Approve the reusable baseline
stages.desc: Adopt what exists; complete only the gaps.
stages.input: Confirmed brief, accepted direction, existing guidelines and verified claims.
stages.skills: Positioning → messaging → voice + visual system → art direction → format templates → manifest
stages.outputs: One Client Foundation Pack: readable guides, structured profiles, tokens and editable examples.
stages.gate: Exact versions approved for their intended uses and proved in real applications.
stages.next: A service brief retrieves only the relevant approved versions.
stages.time: A new identity is a separate sold project; an existing brand can take a shorter route.
stages.failure: Rejected direction → revise the affected artifact and descendants; preserve accepted versions.

stages.title: Run the selected service lanes
stages.desc: Social, web and email share a baseline and have different production steps.
stages.input: Contracted scope, approved foundation versions and actual integration readiness.
stages.skills: Service strategy → brief → production → factual/visual QA → client review → authorised delivery
stages.outputs: Finished assets, site/email/content outputs, approval records and delivery evidence.
stages.gate: Release criteria pass for this output, account and action.
stages.next: Confirmed results feed reporting; failures create recoverable tasks.
stages.time: Batch repetitive production; cap concurrent work to protect review capacity.
stages.failure: Approval rejected → revision task. Provider fails → reconcile before retrying; never assume success.

stages.title: Learn, retain and refine
stages.desc: Use evidence to improve the next cycle without drifting.
stages.input: Delivered scope, dated metrics, client feedback and measured effort.
stages.skills: Measurement → report → review → next-month plan / change request / renewal
stages.outputs: Report, learning log, updated priorities and controlled change requests.
stages.gate: Facts and interpretation are distinguishable; scope changes are explicitly accepted.
stages.next: Repeat delivery; revise a foundation only when the evidence warrants it.
stages.time: One planned monthly review; maintain a light weekly operating review.
stages.failure: Missing metrics → report the gap; no fabricated chart or automatic brand rewrite.
